description: Original Creator: Corbin Smith. This is a somewhat remade and modified version of the original TACZ NPCS mod, adding some features i needed for a modpack and other things. It was based on a decompiled version of the jar, as the github was not updated. Made for 1.21.1 Neoforge

mods.name: TacZ: NPCs
mods.description: Player-like NPCs for the TACZ gun mod.

releases.notes:
Added a lot of new AI changes to NPCs and a lot of new content to NPCs in general. 

They now can follow you and be ordered, including how they engage in combat or how far they follow you.
To ask an npc to follow you you need to have at least 50 reputation (By default) with him. 

There is now reputation with each faction. 

Enemies or allies are now defined by a faction's reputation with another. Because of that the config files have changed. 

Also, there is now C2ME compatibility with a better handler for chunk loading. 


And guns now can have custom npc use rules.

As everything else in the mod, you can configure every aspect of almost anything here. Except the C2ME handlers. The old ones needed to go for sure.
